use.flag: Enable extra tokenizer backends (tiktoken, blobfile, mistral-common)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: GuideLLM is a guidance platform for evaluating and optimizing large language model deployments. It benchmarks LLM inference servers (such as vLLM) under realistic workloads, measuring throughput, latency, and token-level performance to help users understand real-world inference behaviour.
